item.title: Allergens (full list)
item.description: Allergens: 1. Gluten 2. Eggs 3. Fish 4. Peanuts 5. Crustaceans 6. Milk 7. Soy 8. Sesame 9. Nuts 10. Celery 11. Mustard 12. Lupine 13. Sulphur dioxide 14. Molluscs 15. Garlic

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Vegetable tart, a rustic egg tart with autumn leeks, broccoli and carrots in a crisp, buttery pastry, topped with fresh chervil. Served with a fresh, crunchy carrot slaw with lemon juice and raisins. Also available gluten free. (1+2+6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Moroccan lentil and pea protein tagine, an aromatic stew with brown lentils, sweet potatoes and pea protein, spiced with cumin, cinnamon and ginger, served with jasmine rice and topped with toasted almonds. Served with sweet prunes and olives. The dish is gluten free. (9+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: BBQ-marinated roasted cauliflower, served with a hearty beluga lentil stew and a baked potato with coleslaw. (6+10+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Pasta in a soft, creamy pumpkin sauce with hard-roasted mushrooms and a sage and walnut topping. (1+9)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: GREEN DISH: three-bean chili, a rich, slow-simmered chili with kidney beans, black beans, pinto beans and plant protein in a spiced cumin and tomato sauce, served with fluffy long-grain rice and topped with feta-style cheese and parsley. Served with crème fraîche, coriander and lime wedges. Gluten free, and also available with wholegrain rice. (6+15)
